cards.card_text: Up above is where Christ is seated, at the right hand of God, and Paul says set your minds on things above, not on earthly things. Friend, I spent YEARS in a junk drawer staring at the bottom of a takeout menu, so trust me, looking UP is an upgrade.
cards.verse_text: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God. Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
